Hollis, I've replied in our DM. The two issues have different ticket numbers, and the scanner one may be wrong.

1. Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts are ticket #PD-4492. Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in by tablet for the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14 to 18 weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched the SMS routing that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through the gate without manual help. One follow-up was to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window. Nothing says whether that was done. Source: Moss's 5 Oct 2025 prep note for Ruth.

2. The Door 14 barcode scanners failing are ticket #4419, also logged by Thea. On third shift, the gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It went to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing, and I found no record that it was fixed. Source: Moss's undated North cheat sheet.

Check the scanner ticket number before you put it in the file. Marcus Lindqvist's 14 Jul 2025 handoff note gives #4419 to a different problem: a printer delay at Gate 3 that support patched.

Also keep Quarendon Freightways out of the QFL file. It's a different company and not one of our customers.

I couldn't see any Quarrendon account files you have access to. The QFL incident room and the North channels are ones you're not in, so I didn't use them. I searched the brain but didn't open the Central channels directly. What the search returned from them was about other accounts.
